data.title: War Robot Spotlight: Wyrm
data.content:
As a Wild Ten Pilot, it’s good to get to grips with your partner in battle—the War Robot. With several War Robots to choose from, each with its own unique attributes, picking the best ally for each fight is crucial.

An absolute powerhouse in 1 vs 1 encounters, Wyrm disrupts enemy formations with its Reclaimer harpoon, pulling enemies right into the grinder while capitalizing on the reinforced plating and triple heavy weapon loadout.

Starting June 9, Wyrm will be available through Daily Deals and direct offers.

Combat Analysis

  • War Robot Model: Wyrm
  • Class: Assault
  • Dominion: FortEvo

Wyrm is a relentless frontline juggernaut, perfect for Pilots who prefer to force the initiative and dictate the flow of battle through brute strength. Built to thrive in the thick of the crossfire, its exceptional armor plating and three heavy hardpoints allow it to punish enemies up close and dominate any duel.

Wyrm excels at isolating and dismantling key threats using its Reclaimer ability. By dragging targets directly into its dead zone and grinding down their defenses, it creates massive openings for the rest of the squad; its sheer durability ensures it can absorb heavy damage while acting as the ultimate spearhead for the team's advance.

Consider using it with the new Aftershock, a heavy electromagnetic weapon built for short, intense close-range engagements.

Stats shown are for max level, factory build. Stats are subject to change pending future balancing updates.
